versions.name: Artificial Intelligence
versions.description: Tell real artificial intelligence apart from ordinary automation, weigh bias and privacy against usefulness, understand deepfakes and how to respond to one, and practice writing prompts clear enough to get good output.

provenance.notes: Introduced 2025. Confirmed by the project owner and corroborated by the merit-badge ranking series, which places the badge in 2025 and nowhere earlier: Scouting America's 2025 recap gives it the 999 'no prior rank' sentinel for 2024.
